chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: How he got two jobs in New York: Willie Lynch, Chick Webb and Luis Russell
summary: Lynch and Webb both knew of him; Russell's bass player brought Russell to hear him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How do you think you got those jobs? Were people talking about Jay C. Higginbotham, the trombone player? Were people, other musicians, talking about Jay C. Higginbotham, the trombonist, so when you came to New York to see your mother - everybody was interested in hearing you?
Yeah. Willie Lynch and Chick Webb both knew me and had heard of me. They both tried to hire me.
So they both wanted you to work with that band?
Yeah. The bass player heard me and he went out and got Louis Russell and told him about me. So Russell asked me to work for him and that's when I started playing with Louis Russell.
At that particular time you say you didn't work with Willie Lynch or Chick Webb?
No, but I worked with Chick Webb later.
